`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module arbiter #
(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)
(
    input  wire                     clk,
    input  wire                     rst,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         request,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0]         grant,
    output wire                     grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);

reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg = 0, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg = 0, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg = 0, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg = 0, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request;
assign masked_request = request & mask_reg;

wire request_valid;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index;
wire masked_request_valid;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index;

// Keep the frozen encoders for the encoded outputs only.
priority_encoder #(
    .WIDTH(PORTS),
    .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
)
priority_encoder_inst (
    .input_unencoded(request),
    .output_valid(request_valid),
    .output_encoded(request_index),
    .output_unencoded()
);

priority_encoder #(
    .WIDTH(PORTS),
    .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
)
priority_encoder_masked (
    .input_unencoded(masked_request),
    .output_valid(masked_request_valid),
    .output_encoded(masked_request_index),
    .output_unencoded()
);

wire [PORTS-1:0] request_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_rr_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_rr_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_higher;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_higher;

// A bit wins iff it is requested and no higher-priority bit is requested.
// The same higher-priority reduction directly gives each next-mask bit:
// that bit is enabled iff the winning request has higher priority.
generate
    genvar i;
    for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i + 1) begin : direct_priority
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_first
            if (i == 0) begin : endpoint
                assign request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : interior
                assign request_higher[i] = |request[i-1:0];
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = |masked_request[i-1:0];
            end
        end else begin : msb_first
            if (i == PORTS-1) begin : endpoint
                assign request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : interior
                assign request_higher[i] = |request[PORTS-1:i+1];
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:i+1];
            end
        end
        assign request_mask[i] = request[i] & ~request_higher[i];
        assign masked_request_mask[i] = masked_request[i] & ~masked_request_higher[i];
        assign request_rr_mask[i] = request_higher[i];
        assign masked_request_rr_mask[i] = masked_request_higher[i];
    end
endgenerate

always @* begin
    grant_next = 0;
    grant_valid_next = 0;
    grant_encoded_next = 0;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (grant_reg & request)) begin
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid && !(grant_reg & acknowledge)) begin
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (request_valid) begin
        if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
            if (masked_request_valid) begin
                grant_valid_next = 1;
                grant_next = masked_request_mask;
                grant_encoded_next = masked_request_index;
                mask_next = masked_request_rr_mask;
            end else begin
                grant_valid_next = 1;
                grant_next = request_mask;
                grant_encoded_next = request_index;
                mask_next = request_rr_mask;
            end
        end else begin
            grant_valid_next = 1;
            grant_next = request_mask;
            grant_encoded_next = request_index;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    grant_reg <= grant_next;
    grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
    grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
    mask_reg <= mask_next;

    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end
end

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original round-robin feedback path passes through priority encoding, index-dependent arithmetic and a variable shift before updating mask_reg. Its grant path also decodes the encoded winner back into a one-hot vector. These are plausible setup bottlenecks; no timing report was provided to establish the actual critical path.",
  "rewrite": "Retain the frozen priority_encoder instances for valid and encoded results, but disconnect their one-hot outputs. Compute one-hot winners directly using parallel higher-priority request reductions. Reuse those reductions as the next round-robin mask, eliminating index arithmetic and variable shifts. Preserve the original selection, blocking and sequential-update structure.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The mask feedback path should require fewer serial logic stages, and one-hot grants no longer depend on encoded-index decoding. Actual WNS improvement is unmeasured and must be established by synthesis and STA at the fixed settings; encoded-output or blocking-control paths may instead limit timing.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel reductions may add logic alongside the retained encoded-output trees, although synthesis can share reductions and remove unused decoder logic. No registers or pipeline stages are added. Mapped area must be checked against the 4880.43072 um2 cap; compliance has not been measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For each nonempty request vector, the higher-priority reduction is exactly the mask permitting positions after the selected winner in the configured priority order. This holds for arbitrary simultaneous request bits and for masked requests. Empty-vector direct winners differ from the helper's unused invalid one-hot result, but the original valid guards prevent their selection. The candidate retains parameter names/defaults, native ports and widths, original register initialization semantics, synchronous active-high reset, blocking/acknowledge behavior, mask retention, and edge-sampled output latency. It adds no startup assumptions and does not redefine the dependency. Formal equivalence against the frozen original, including reset after startup, remains required for the specified parameter instance."
}
